name: SpatialScene
tagline: 在 iOS 15–18 上导入、下载并呈现具有空间层次的动态壁纸。
description: SpatialScene 让你通过 App 导入或在线下载空间壁纸，进行预览、管理并设为当前壁纸。
启用后，壁纸会随设备姿态呈现自然的空间层次与动态效果，并减少旋转或转场时短暂露出系统原壁纸。
你还可以调整锁屏时间外观，并尝试让壁纸前景自然遮挡时间的实验性景深效果。
notice: ⚠️ 如同时使用 LiquidAss 自定义时钟，请前往 LiquidAss > 表面 > 锁屏 > 时钟，关闭“启用”，避免与 SpatialScene 时间样式冲突。
features: 导入兼容的空间壁纸包
浏览带预览图的在线壁纸库
预览、管理并设置当前壁纸
随设备姿态呈现空间层次效果
可按需启用主屏幕动态效果
支持实时切换“桌面使用原壁纸”，无需 Respring
旋转与转场期间提供静态回退，减少系统原壁纸露出
调整锁屏时间高度、粗细、颜色与不透明度
根据当前壁纸自动匹配时间颜色，或手动选择颜色
实验性景深效果可让壁纸前景自然遮挡时间
检测 LiquidAss 自定义时钟冲突并提供关闭指引
保持锁屏时间、通知与正在播放控件正常显示和交互
可与 DynamicMusicBG 同时使用
usage: 从在线壁纸库下载，或导入兼容的空间壁纸包。
预览壁纸并将喜欢的项目设为当前。
在系统“设置”中启用 SpatialScene，并按需开启主屏幕动态效果。
在时间设置中调整高度、粗细与颜色；实验性景深效果可按需开启。
如需保留系统桌面壁纸，可开启“桌面使用原壁纸”，设置会立即生效。

changes: 新增旋转与转场静态回退，并支持实时切换“桌面使用原壁纸”。
新增 LiquidAss 自定义时钟冲突检测及明确的关闭指引。
重新设计设置页 Slider，修复重复覆盖冲突并完善三语文本。
新增 iOS 15–18 锁屏时间高度、粗细、颜色与不透明度调整，并支持自动匹配壁纸颜色。
新增实验性景深效果，可让 3D 壁纸前景自然遮挡时间。
修复 iOS 15 放大时间后的日期布局，并完善三语设置文本与实时生效体验。
修复锁屏壁纸可能遮挡时间、通知或正在播放控件并影响交互的问题。
修复通知中心下拉、停住与收回时壁纸不同步或残留的问题。
增强与 DynamicMusicBG 同时使用及插件禁用后的壁纸状态恢复稳定性。
修复插件关闭后，下拉锁屏或通知中心的壁纸图层仍可能保持透明的问题。
增强与其他壁纸插件同时安装时的图层状态恢复稳定性。
新增 iOS 15 支持，并恢复 App 网络与在线壁纸下载。
修复 iOS 16 上的兼容性问题与部分功能异常。
修复 RootHide 环境下在线壁纸下载失败的问题。
修复 iOS 16 上空间场景壁纸无法正常显示的问题。
新增在线壁纸库，可直接浏览预览并下载空间壁纸。
新增后台下载支持，离开 App 后仍可继续完成下载与安装。
增强下载校验、失败恢复及预览加载稳定性。

en.name: SpatialScene
en.tagline: Import, download, and enjoy layered spatial wallpapers on iOS 15–18.
description: SpatialScene lets you import or download spatial wallpapers in the app, preview and manage them, and set one as current.
Once enabled, wallpapers respond to device movement with natural layered depth effects while reducing brief flashes of the stock wallpaper during rotations and transitions.
You can also customize the Lock Screen clock and try an experimental depth effect that lets wallpaper foregrounds naturally overlap it.
en.notice: ⚠️ If you use LiquidAss clock customization, open LiquidAss > Surfaces > Lock Screen > Clock and disable “Enabled” to avoid conflicts with SpatialScene clock styling.
features: Import compatible spatial wallpaper packages
Browse an online wallpaper library with previews
Preview, manage, and set the current wallpaper
Motion-responsive layered depth effects
Optional Home Screen animation
Switch to the stock Home Screen wallpaper instantly without a Respring
Static fallback during rotations and transitions to reduce stock-wallpaper flashes
Adjust Lock Screen clock height, weight, color, and opacity
Match the clock color to the current wallpaper automatically or choose one manually
Experimental depth effect that lets wallpaper foregrounds overlap the clock
Detect LiquidAss custom-clock conflicts and provide clear disable guidance
Keep the clock, notifications, and Now Playing controls visible and interactive
Coexist with DynamicMusicBG
usage: Open the SpatialScene app after installation.
Download a wallpaper from the online library or import a compatible package.
Preview a wallpaper and set your preferred item as current.
Enable SpatialScene in the system Settings app and turn on Home Screen animation if desired.
Use Clock settings to adjust height, weight, and color, and optionally enable the experimental depth effect.
Enable Use Stock Home Wallpaper to keep the system Home Screen wallpaper; the change applies immediately.

changes: Added static fallback during rotations and transitions, plus instant switching to the stock Home Screen wallpaper.
Added LiquidAss custom-clock conflict detection with clear disable guidance.
Redesigned Settings sliders, fixed duplicate overlay conflicts, and improved trilingual text.
Added Lock Screen clock height, weight, color, and opacity controls on iOS 15–18, including automatic wallpaper color matching.
Added an experimental depth effect that lets 3D wallpaper foregrounds naturally overlap the clock.
Fixed date layout after enlarging the clock on iOS 15 and improved trilingual Settings text and live updates.
Fixed the Lock Screen wallpaper covering or blocking the clock, notifications, or Now Playing controls.
Fixed wallpaper movement or residue issues while pulling down, holding, or dismissing Notification Center.
Improved coexistence with DynamicMusicBG and wallpaper-state restoration after disabling the tweak.
Fixed wallpaper layers remaining transparent in the Lock Screen or Notification Center after the tweak was disabled.
Improved layer-state restoration when used alongside other wallpaper tweaks.
Added iOS 15 support and restored app networking and online wallpaper downloads.
Fixed compatibility issues and feature failures on iOS 16.
Fixed online wallpaper download failures in RootHide environments.
Fixed an issue that prevented spatial wallpapers from displaying correctly on iOS 16.
Added an online wallpaper library with previews and direct downloads.
Added background downloads that can continue outside the app.
Improved download verification, failure recovery, and preview loading reliability.
